facts.fact: EuroMedAI says the CNDP issued guidance at the end of August 2026 to political parties on processing voters' data under Law No. 09-08.
EuroMedAI says the CNDP, the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection, issued guidance under Law No. 09-08 and opened a helpline, 3020.
EuroMedAI says the CNDP's guidance to parties recalls duties to declare processing, obtain consent and control transfers abroad, and asks that AI-produced content be identified.
